data: What is the accuracy of the red line for 5000 training documents?

The red line represents CorrNet. The x-axis shows the number of documents for the train set, ranging from 100 to 10000. The y-axis shows accuracy in percentage, ranging from 55% to 80%. The red line starts at approximately 70% accuracy when the number of documents is 100 and increases steadily with an increase in the number of documents. At 5000 training documents, the red line reaches approximately 77% accuracy. Therefore, the accuracy of the red line for 5000 training documents is around 77%.
